set.typical_award_size: HCD formula allocations to the County: $226,380 (CY 2024) and $238,273 (CY 2025), with an estimated $1,414,875 for the 2024-2028 cycle; the City of Madera receives its own allocation ($296,439 in 2024, $317,530 in 2025; estimated $1,852,744 for 2024-2028). The County's PLHA five-year plan and activity choices were not located (County website blocked).
set.affordability_requirement: PLHA Guidelines Section 301: rental activities must be affordable to extremely low, very low, low or moderate income households (up to 120% AMI), and workforce rental and ownership activities may serve households up to 120% AMI; plans must prioritize households at or below 60% AMI. Rental projects need a 55-year regulatory agreement and PLHA must be a low-interest deferred loan to the sponsor.
set.cycle_notes: HCD releases each calendar-year allocation to the County, which applies on a rolling basis under its five-year plan; CY 2024 funds must be requested by February 2028 and CY 2025 by February 2029. No County NOFA to developers was found.
set.prevailing_wage_basis: Neither the 2019 PLHA Final Guidelines nor the 2024-2028 PLHA Formula Allocation NOFA states a prevailing wage requirement; coverage would depend on Labor Code 1720 for the specific project.
set.audit_note: Award figures confirmed in the HCD NOFA tables; AMI corrected from 80% to the Section 301 limits (moderate income up to 120% AMI, 60% AMI priority); prevailing wage reset to unclear because no rule was cited. County plan activities still unconfirmed, so eligible_project_types remain unverified.

reason: NOFA confirms the allocations and adds a $1,414,875 five-year estimate, but the AMI language was wrong and the County plan could not be read, so confidence stays needs_confirmation.
